geometry.distance_metric: great-circle Haversine distance between Census county internal points
geometry.interpretation: response-blind analyst-choice county-centroid structural geometry, not SLF movement distance

scale_ladder.construction: minimum observed Haversine threshold reaching each target under the existing world_scale_ladder implementation

gate1_pass_if: at least three distinct positive structural thresholds are constructed
geo_lcc900 largest weak component fraction is at least 0.90
geo_lcc900 isolated-node fraction is at most 0.05
all four edge sets are nested and deterministic under the frozen geometry
gate1_stop_if: fewer than three distinct positive structural scales exist
the 0.90 world fails the frozen LCC or isolation criteria
the frozen Census node/geometry fingerprint cannot be reproduced
next_if_pass: freeze Layer-A rule universe without using response rows
include at least one long-distance-capable rule because human-mediated spread is plausible
freeze external county-spread comparators, runtime and once-only outcome rules
only then open county response once
no_rescue: Do not replace the county geometry with a kNN graph, future-response 166-county region, response-tuned thresholds, or alternative scale targets after this declaration.
